1.name: Gate 63 Line 1 - Entry to pressure; restrain the urge to discharge prematurely.
1.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] entry-inner | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 1 is entry to Voltage — first contact with pressure that will eventually discharge as current. "Braking wheels" = restraining the urge to rush. "Tail in water" = the crossing is beginning, but control is maintained. At -2 (Voltage), entry requires recognizing pressure without acting on it prematurely.
1.desc: Shadow: The pressure in achievement to still doubt one's capabilities and to immediately seek new goals. | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

2.name: Gate 63 Line 2 - Building pressure-structure; trust that what's lost during development returns.
2.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] development-inner | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 2 is development at Voltage — building the structure for the crossing. "Losing the curtain" = something drops away during development. "Don't chase it; it returns" = trust the development process. At -2, development means building pressure-capacity. What falls away will return when the crossing completes.
2.desc: Shadow: Doubts that one can maintain ones program when interacting with others. | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

3.name: Gate 63 Line 3 - Peak pressure at threshold; sustained discipline for quality crossing.
3.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] completion-inner | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 3 is peak Voltage before crossing — maximum pressure before discharge. "Disciplining the devil's country" = the pre-threshold work is difficult. "Three years" = sustained effort. "Inferior people must not be employed" = the crossing requires quality. At -2 completion, pressure is maximum. The zero-crossing is imminent.
3.desc: Shadow: The pressure to explore the doubt in detail as a foundation for eventual formulating. | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

4.name: Gate 63 Line 4 - Entry to flow reveals completion's imperfection; remember the lessons.
4.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] entry-outer | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 4 is entry to Current after crossing. "Finest clothes turn to rags" = what seemed complete at Voltage appears different at Current. "Be careful all day long" = the new state is vulnerable. After crossing from -2 to +2, the first contact with flow reveals imperfections in what was achieved.
4.desc: Shadow: The understanding that doubts are necessary and of value. | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

5.name: Gate 63 Line 5 - Development in flow values sincerity over display.
5.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] development-outer | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flow. The east/west neighbor comparison: elaborate effort matters less than sincere presence. At +2, development isn't about more pressure — it's about quality of flow.
5.desc: Shadow: The logic of leaving old doubts behind. | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

6.name: Gate 63 Line 6 - Complete immersion in flow; danger of losing or obsessing over origin.
6.asc: [cross-zero-manifesting] completion-outer | Fire (-2) → Water (2) || Line 6 is completion at Current — the crossing is fully done. "Head in water" = fully immersed in flow. "Danger" = complete immersion risks losing connection to what created the crossing (Voltage). At +2 completion, the danger is forgetting the origin or becoming obsessed with it.
6.desc: Shadow: Material abundance without spiritual light | Vector: -2→2 (outward) | Axis: flow

1.name: Gate 64 Line 1 - Entry to flow already beginning dissolution; find harmony in the awkward conditions.
1.asc: [cross-zero-dematerialising] entry-inner | Water (2) → Fire (-2) || Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flow that will eventually dissolve. "Tail in water" (same image as Gate 63.1) but here "humiliating" — entry to flow in a dematerialising gate is awkward. You're entering what's about to dissolve. At +2 (Current), entry in Gate 64 means contacting flow while knowing dissolution is coming.
1.desc: Shadow: Inner development that can end the confusion over what makes sense. | Vector: 2→-2 (outward) | Axis: flow

2.name: Gate 64 Line 2 - Reducing flow-momentum; developing qualities needed for the crossing back.
2.asc: [cross-zero-dematerialising] development-inner | Water (2) → Fire (-2) || Line 2 is development at Current preparing for dematerialisation. "Braking wheels" = restraining flow. The same image appears in Gate 63.1, but here it's development at Current — slowing flow to prepare for return to Voltage. At +2, development for dematerialisation means reducing flow-momentum, preparing for pressure.
2.desc: Shadow: Stagnation during development | Vector: 2→-2 (outward) | Axis: flow

3.name: Gate 64 Line 3 - Peak flow before crossing; don't force, but prepare for the great crossing.
3.asc: [cross-zero-dematerialising] completion-inner | Water (2) → Fire (-2) || Line 3 is peak Current before crossing — maximum flow before dematerialisation. "Attack brings misfortune" = don't force the crossing. "Crossing great water" = the zero-crossing is the goal, but timing matters. At +2 completion, flow is at maximum. The pressure for dematerialisation is building.
3.desc: Shadow: The assuredness that confusion is a process that results in realization. | Vector: 2→-2 (outward) | Axis: flow

4.name: Gate 64 Line 4 - Entry to pressure; conviction that the crossing was right.
4.asc: [cross-zero-dematerialising] entry-outer | Water (2) → Fire (-2) || Line 4 is entry to Voltage after crossing. "Perseverance brings good fortune" = having made the crossing, persistence is rewarded. "Remorse disappears" = doubts about the dematerialisation dissolve. "Three years" = sustained development at Voltage yields results. At -2 entry, the arrival at pressure after dissolving flow requires conviction.
4.desc: Shadow: Confusion over which values and relationships can bring harmony. | Vector: 2→-2 (outward) | Axis: flow

5.name: Gate 64 Line 5 - Developing pressure that illuminates; the promise of what this crossing enables.

At Voltage, development means increasing capacity to hold potential difference — the promise of future flow.

"Drinking wine in confidence" = celebrating completion. "But wetting one's head = excess" = don't over-indulge at the peak. At -2 completion, Voltage is fully restored. The Flow axis crossing (from Current to Voltage) is done. But excess at completion inverts the achievement.
